en.description:
TRUTH OR DARE SHOUTOUT

The ultimate talking Truth or Dare party game for iPhone and iPad!

Get ready for hilarious challenges, embarrassing confessions and unforgettable moments with Truth or Dare Shoutout!

Whether you’re hosting a party, enjoying a family games night, hanging out with friends or spending an evening with your partner, Truth or Dare Shoutout brings the classic party game to life!

With thousands of questions, spoken announcements, a spinning bottle and exciting countdown timers, the fun never stops!

TRUTH OR DARE?

Choose Truth and answer a question honestly, or pick Dare and complete a hilarious challenge!

With thousands of questions and dares across different categories, there’s something for everyone.

SPIN THE BOTTLE

Let fate decide!

Watch the bottle spin around before slowing down and stopping at a random position.

Choose from 10 fun spinner designs to personalise your game.

VOICE ANNOUNCEMENTS

Let your iPhone do the talking!

Truth or Dare Shoutout reads questions and challenges aloud using a natural-sounding voice.

Turn announcements on or off whenever you like.

ADD YOUR FRIENDS

Enter your players’ names and let the game randomly choose whose turn it is.

Perfect for parties, family gatherings and groups of friends!

CHOOSE YOUR CATEGORY

Find the perfect questions for every occasion:

• Classic – Traditional Truth or Dare fun.
• Funny – Hilarious questions and silly challenges.
• Friends – Perfect for games nights.
• Couples – Questions to get to know each other better.
• Party – Fun challenges for group entertainment.
• Spicy – Add a little extra excitement!

COUNTDOWN TIMER

Make every challenge more exciting with the built-in countdown timer.

Choose a countdown from 3 to 60 seconds and race against the clock!

ENGLISH & SPANISH

Play in English or Spanish!

Choose your preferred question language and enjoy spoken announcements in your selected language.

REMOVE ADVERTISING

Enjoy Truth or Dare Shoutout for free with advertising.

Prefer an uninterrupted experience?

Upgrade with a single one-off in-app purchase to remove advertising.

No subscription required!

PERFECT FOR EVERY OCCASION

• Birthday parties
• Family games nights
• Parties with friends
• Couples’ evenings
• Holidays and gatherings
• Sleepovers

Gather your friends, choose Truth or Dare and get ready for some unforgettable moments!

TRUTH OR DARE? YOU DECIDE!
en.releaseNotes: We have now added support for the iPhone Duo
en.subtitle: The Ultimate Party Game
